subject: DI01000191

intro_text.en: English/Gujarati concept-focused notes: pure substance, steam formation/types, superheat, quality/wetness and priming. Notes include simple interpretation examples; Exam contains questions only.
intro_text.gu: English/ગુજરાતી concept-focused notes: Pure substance, Steam formation/types, Superheat, Quality/Wetness અને Priming. Notes માં સરળ examples; Exam માં માત્ર પ્રશ્નો.

body.en:
A pure substance has a fixed chemical composition throughout the system under consideration. It may exist in more than one phase: liquid water and water vapour can together form a pure-substance system because both have the chemical identity H₂O.

Phase refers to a physically distinct, approximately uniform form such as solid, liquid or vapour. Changing phase does not necessarily change chemical composition. Ice melting to liquid water is a physical change, not creation of a new chemical substance.

Contrast: seawater contains dissolved salts, so it is not pure H₂O. A mixture can sometimes be treated as a pure substance in a simplified model when its composition stays uniform, but phase separation can invalidate that simplification.
body.gu:
Pure substance એટલે અભ્યાસ હેઠળના system માં chemical composition નિશ્ચિત હોય. એકથી વધારે phase હોઈ શકે: liquid water અને water vapour બંને H₂O હોવાથી મળીને pure-substance system બનાવી શકે.

Phase એટલે solid, liquid અથવા vapour જેવું physically distinct અને લગભગ uniform સ્વરૂપ. Phase બદલાય એટલે chemical composition બદલાય જ એવું નથી. Ice થી liquid water થવું physical change છે.

ફરક: Seawater માં salts હોવાથી તે pure H₂O નથી. Composition uniform રહે ત્યારે અમુક mixture ને simplified pure-substance model થી સમજાવી શકાય, પણ phase separation થાય તો તે approximation ખોટી પડી શકે.

body.en:
Steam is water in its vapour state. Engineering discussions also use “wet steam” for a liquid-water/water-vapour mixture. Steam transfers energy in boilers, turbines, heating systems and industrial processes.

Water vapour is invisible. A visible white plume commonly consists mainly of tiny liquid droplets formed by condensation in cooler air. Absence of a visible cloud does not mean hot vapour is absent.

Safety: hot steam and condensate can cause severe burns. This unit uses diagrams and conceptual examples only; do not open pressurised fittings, approach leaks or heat a sealed vessel.
body.gu:
Steam એટલે water ની vapour state. Engineering માં Wet steam શબ્દ liquid water અને water vapour ના mixture માટે પણ વપરાય છે. Boilers, turbines, heating અને industries માં energy transfer માટે ઉપયોગી છે.

Water vapour invisible છે. દેખાતું સફેદ cloud સામાન્ય રીતે ઠંડી હવામાં condensation થી બનેલા નાના water droplets છે. Cloud ન દેખાય એટલે hot vapour નથી એવું માનવું નહીં.

Safety: Steam અને hot condensate ગંભીર burns કરી શકે. અહીં diagrams/conceptual examples છે; pressurised fitting ખોલવું, leak નજીક જવું અથવા sealed vessel ગરમ કરવું નહીં.

body.en:
Saturation temperature Tsat is the liquid–vapour equilibrium temperature at a specified pressure. Saturation pressure psat is the corresponding equilibrium pressure at a specified temperature. For pure water below its critical point, the two are linked.

At approximately 101.325 kPa absolute, water boils near 100 °C. At a lower pressure the saturation temperature is lower; at a higher pressure it is higher. Water does not always boil at 100 °C.

Use absolute pressure when looking up saturation properties. A gauge reading alone needs the local atmospheric reference. Saturation values come from appropriate water/steam property tables or validated property software, not from a single fixed universal boiling temperature.
body.gu:
Saturation temperature Tsat એટલે આપેલા pressure પર liquid–vapour equilibrium temperature. Saturation pressure psat એટલે આપેલા temperature માટેનું equilibrium pressure. Pure water માટે critical point ની નીચે બંને જોડાયેલાં છે.

લગભગ 101.325 kPa absolute પર water લગભગ 100 °C એ boil થાય. Pressure ઓછું હોય તો Tsat ઓછું અને pressure વધારે હોય તો Tsat વધારે. Water હંમેશાં 100 °C એ boil થતું નથી.

Steam table માટે absolute pressure લો; gauge reading ને atmosphere reference જોઈએ. Property values યોગ્ય tables/validated software માંથી લો.

title.en: 3.2 Formation of Steam at Constant Pressure

h.en: 3.2.1 The heating model and its limits

body.en:
Consider a fixed mass of pure water heated in a conceptual piston–cylinder at a maintained constant pressure below the critical pressure. A movable boundary allows expansion. Assume slow, approximately equilibrium changes and neglect unwanted losses for the teaching picture.

The sequence is subcooled liquid → saturated liquid → wet liquid–vapour mixture → dry saturated vapour → superheated vapour.

This is not a rigid sealed pressure-cooker experiment: heating a rigid sealed container generally changes pressure, so the simple constant-pressure picture cannot be applied unchanged.
body.gu:
Conceptual piston–cylinder માં fixed mass pure water ને critical pressure કરતાં ઓછા constant pressure પર ગરમ કરીએ. Movable boundary થી expansion થાય. Teaching model માં ધીમો equilibrium process અને losses અવગણીએ.

ક્રમ: Subcooled liquid → Saturated liquid → Wet mixture → Dry saturated vapour → Superheated vapour.

આ rigid sealed vessel નો practical નથી. Rigid sealed container ગરમ કરતાં pressure સામાન્ય રીતે બદલાય છે, એટલે આ constant-pressure model સીધો ન લાગુ પડે.

h.en: 3.2.2 Stage A–B: heating liquid to saturation
h.gu: 3.2.2 Stage A–B: Liquid ને Saturation સુધી ગરમ કરવું

body.en:
Subcooled/compressed liquid has a temperature below the saturation temperature for its pressure. As heat is supplied at the stated constant pressure, liquid temperature rises toward Tsat.

At Tsat, the liquid is saturated liquid: it is at the liquid-side boundary of boiling. In the ideal equilibrium picture, additional heat begins vaporisation rather than raising the mixture temperature immediately.

Teaching example: at approximately atmospheric pressure, liquid initially near room temperature is heated toward 100 °C. This example does not define all water/steam states at every pressure.
body.gu:
Subcooled/compressed liquid નું temperature તેના pressure માટેના Tsat કરતાં ઓછું હોય છે. Constant pressure પર heat આપતાં temperature Tsat સુધી વધે છે.

Tsat પર તે Saturated liquid છે: boiling ની liquid-side boundary. Ideal equilibrium picture માં વધુ heat આપવાથી vaporisation શરૂ થાય છે; mixture નું T તરત વધતું નથી.

ઉદાહરણ: લગભગ atmospheric pressure પર room-temperature water ને લગભગ 100 °C તરફ ગરમ કરવું. આ તમામ pressure માટેનું universal value નથી.

h.en: 3.2.3 Stage B–C: evaporation and latent heat
h.gu: 3.2.3 Stage B–C: Evaporation અને Latent Heat

body.en:
During equilibrium boiling of a pure substance at the maintained constant pressure, added heat converts liquid to vapour while temperature stays at Tsat. This phase-change energy is associated with latent heat of vaporisation.

The vapour mass increases and liquid mass decreases. Intermediate states contain both phases and are called wet steam. At the vapour-side end, the last equilibrium liquid disappears and the state is dry saturated vapour.

Constant temperature does not mean no energy is supplied. In this process energy changes phase-related properties and supports expansion. Latent heat and the difference between saturated-vapour and saturated-liquid enthalpy depend on pressure.
body.gu:
Pure substance નું constant-pressure equilibrium boiling ચાલે ત્યારે heat liquid ને vapour માં ફેરવે છે, પણ T Tsat પર રહે છે. આ phase-change energy ને Latent heat of vaporisation સાથે સમજીએ.

Vapour mass વધે અને liquid mass ઘટે. વચ્ચેના two-phase states Wet steam છે. Vapour-side end પર છેલ્લું equilibrium liquid ગાયબ થાય અને dry saturated vapour મળે.

T સ્થિર એટલે energy આપવી નથી એવું નહીં. Energy phase-related change અને expansion માં જાય છે. Latent heat pressure પ્રમાણે બદલાય છે.

body.en:
After all equilibrium liquid has vaporised, further heating at the same pressure raises vapour temperature above Tsat. The result is superheated steam.

Example: at a pressure for which Tsat=100 °C, vapour at 150 °C is superheated by 50 degrees. At another pressure with Tsat greater than 150 °C, the same temperature does not imply superheated steam.

Temperature must always be compared with Tsat at the same pressure. The visible presence or absence of a white plume is not a reliable measurement of superheat.
body.gu:
બધું equilibrium liquid vapour થયા પછી same pressure પર વધુ heat આપીએ તો vapour નું T, Tsat થી ઉપર જાય. આ Superheated steam છે.

ઉદાહરણ: જે pressure પર Tsat=100 °C હોય ત્યાં 150 °C steam માટે superheat 50 degrees છે. બીજા pressure પર Tsat જ 150 °C કરતાં વધારે હોય તો માત્ર 150 °C જોઈને superheated ન કહી શકાય.

હંમેશાં same pressure ના Tsat સાથે compare કરો. સફેદ cloud દેખાવું/ન દેખાવું superheat નું measurement નથી.

body.en:
Wet steam is a two-phase mixture of liquid water and water vapour. In an ideal equilibrium saturated mixture, both phases share the saturation condition for the mixture pressure.

The liquid may be present as droplets; the overall vapour mass fraction determines the dryness fraction/quality. “Wet” does not mean a separate chemical species or merely high room humidity.

Application concern: droplets in high-speed steam equipment can contribute to erosion and energy-performance losses. Moisture control matters, but this is not a procedure for operating live turbines or boilers.
body.gu:
Wet steam એટલે liquid water અને water vapour નું two-phase mixture. Ideal equilibrium saturated mixture માં બંને phases pressure માટેની saturation condition પર હોય છે.

Liquid droplets સ્વરૂપે હોઈ શકે. Vapour નો mass fraction એટલે Dryness fraction/Quality. Wet એટલે અલગ chemical substance અથવા ફક્ત room humidity નહીં.

અસર: High-speed steam equipment માં droplets erosion અને performance loss માં ફાળો આપી શકે. અહીં live boiler/turbine operation ની procedure નથી.

body.en:
Dry saturated steam is saturated water vapour at the vapour boundary, without an equilibrium liquid fraction in the ideal state. Its temperature equals Tsat at its pressure.

It is not superheated. Removing a small amount of heat at constant pressure can begin condensation, producing a wet mixture.

At the saturated-vapour endpoint, quality x=1 by the endpoint convention. Real measurements must establish pressure/state; “dry” as an informal appearance label is not a complete thermodynamic specification.
body.gu:
Dry saturated steam saturated-vapour boundary પર છે; ideal state માં equilibrium liquid fraction નથી. તેનું T તે pressure ના Tsat જેટલું છે.

તે superheated નથી. Same pressure પર થોડી heat કાઢીએ તો condensation શરૂ થઈ શકે અને wet mixture બને.

Saturated-vapour endpoint માટે convention મુજબ x=1. ફક્ત દેખાવ પરથી dry કહી દેવું પૂરતું નથી; pressure અને state જાણવા જોઈએ.

body.en:
ConditionPhases in ideal pictureTemperature at given pressureQuality x
Wet steamLiquid + vapourTsatBetween 0 and 1
Dry saturated steamSaturated vapour boundaryTsat1 at endpoint
Superheated steamSingle vapour phaseAbove TsatNot defined as saturated-mixture quality

Do not assign x=1.1 to superheated steam. Quality is not a thermometer scale; it is a two-phase mass fraction. Superheated vapour and saturated vapour are both liquid-free in their ideal states, but their state conditions differ.
body.gu:
ConditionIdeal phasesઆપેલા p પર TQuality x
WetLiquid + vapourTsat0 અને 1 વચ્ચે
Dry saturatedSaturated vapour boundaryTsatEndpoint પર 1
SuperheatedSingle vapour phaseTsat થી વધારેSaturated-mixture quality લાગુ નથી

Superheated steam માટે x=1.1 ન લખવું. Quality temperature scale નથી; two-phase mass fraction છે. Ideal dry saturated અને superheated બંને liquid-free છે, પણ state condition જુદી છે.

body.en:
Degree of superheat is the difference between actual superheated-steam temperature and saturation temperature at the same pressure:

ΔTsuperheat = Tsup − Tsat(p).

Example: if Tsat at the stated pressure is 120 °C and actual steam temperature is 180 °C, degree of superheat is 60 K, numerically also a 60 °C temperature difference.

This is a temperature difference, not heat energy. Differences have the same numerical value in K and °C, although absolute temperature values do not.
body.gu:
Degree of superheat એટલે actual superheated steam T અને same pressure ના Tsat વચ્ચેનો તફાવત:

ΔTsuperheat = Tsup − Tsat(p).

ઉદાહરણ: Tsat=120 °C અને actual T=180 °C હોય તો superheat 60 K, એટલે numerical temperature difference 60 °C પણ.

આ Temperature difference છે, Heat energy નહીં. Difference માટે K/°C ની numerical value સમાન હોય છે; absolute temperature values સમાન નથી.

body.en:
Heat of superheat is the energy supplied in taking dry saturated steam to a superheated state under the specified process. For suitable constant-pressure simple heating, the heat per unit mass corresponds to hsup − hg, where hg is saturated-vapour enthalpy at that pressure.

The common introductory approximation qsuperheat≈Cp,avg(Tsup−Tsat) requires a suitable average vapour heat capacity and stated conditions. The total energy is Q=mq. Do not treat the approximation as an exact constant-Cp property law across all steam states.

The syllabus asks for the concept: no steam-table numerical exercise or derivation is required here. Distinguish this energy, measured in kJ/kg or kJ, from degree of superheat, measured as a temperature difference.
body.gu:
Heat of superheat એટલે specified process માં dry saturated steam ને superheated state સુધી લઈ જવા આપેલી energy. યોગ્ય simple constant-pressure heating માં unit mass દીઠ heat hsup − hg સાથે સંબંધિત છે; hg તે pressure પર saturated-vapour enthalpy છે.

Basic approximation qsuperheat≈Cp,avg(Tsup−Tsat) માટે યોગ્ય average Cp અને conditions જોઈએ. કુલ Q=mq. દરેક steam state માટે Cp હંમેશાં constant છે એવું ન માનો.

Syllabus માં concept જોઈએ છે; અહીં steam-table numerical/derivation જરૂરી નથી. Heat energy kJ/kg અથવા kJ માં અને degree of superheat temperature difference માં છે.

h.gu: 3.4.3 Superheated Steam ને ઠંડું કરતાં ક્રમ

body.en:
At maintained constant pressure, cooling initially superheated steam first reduces its temperature toward Tsat. Only after reaching the saturated-vapour boundary does further cooling produce an equilibrium liquid fraction.

The conceptual sequence is superheated vapour → dry saturated vapour → wet mixture → saturated liquid → subcooled liquid, if cooling continues under the stated conditions.

Do not say superheated steam must instantly condense whenever any heat is removed. The amount of superheat and pressure determine the initial state path.
body.gu:
Constant pressure પર superheated steam માંથી heat કાઢતાં પહેલાં T, Tsat તરફ ઘટે છે. Saturated-vapour boundary સુધી આવ્યા પછી વધુ cooling થી equilibrium liquid fraction બને.

ક્રમ: Superheated → Dry saturated → Wet mixture → Saturated liquid → Subcooled liquid, જો એ conditions માં cooling ચાલુ રાખીએ.

કોઈપણ થોડી heat કાઢતાં superheated steam તરત condense જ થાય એવું ન લખવું. Initial superheat અને pressure મહત્વના છે.

body.en:
Dryness fraction x, also called steam quality in this saturated-mixture context, is the vapour mass divided by total liquid-plus-vapour mass:

x = mv/(mv+ml).

It is dimensionless and may be expressed as a fraction or percentage. In the wet region, 0<x<1. Saturated-liquid and saturated-vapour endpoints conventionally have x=0 and x=1.

Interpretation: x=0.90 means 90% of the mixture mass is vapour and 10% is liquid. It does not mean 90% of its volume is vapour, nor that temperature is 90 °C.
body.gu:
Dryness fraction x અથવા આ saturated-mixture context માં Steam quality, vapour mass ને કુલ liquid+vapour mass થી ભાગતાં મળે:

x = mv/(mv+ml).

તે dimensionless છે; fraction અથવા percentage લખી શકાય. Wet region માં 0<x<1. Endpoints પર saturated liquid માટે 0 અને saturated vapour માટે 1.

અર્થ: x=0.90 એટલે mass ના 90% vapour અને 10% liquid. આ volume ના 90% નથી અને T=90 °C પણ નથી.

h.en: 3.5.2 Wetness fraction and a simple interpretation

body.en:
Wetness fraction y is liquid mass divided by total mixture mass: y=ml/(mv+ml)=1−x.

Concept illustration: a model mixture has 9 kg vapour and 1 kg liquid. Total mass is 10 kg; x=9/10=0.90, wetness=1/10=0.10. Its stated quality is 90% by mass.

This small ratio illustrates meaning, not an extended numerical syllabus requirement. As vaporisation proceeds at constant pressure, x increases while wetness decreases.
body.gu:
Wetness fraction y એટલે liquid mass/total mass: y=ml/(mv+ml)=1−x.

સમજ માટે: model mixture માં 9 kg vapour અને 1 kg liquid હોય તો total 10 kg. x=9/10=0.90 અને wetness=1/10=0.10. Quality mass પ્રમાણે 90% છે.

આ ફક્ત concept સમજાવતો ratio છે, લાંબો numerical syllabus requirement નહીં. Constant pressure પર vaporisation વધે તેમ x વધે અને wetness ઘટે.

h.en: 3.5.3 Quality is not a general purity rating
h.gu: 3.5.3 Quality એટલે General Purity Rating નહીં

body.en:
Thermodynamic steam quality describes the liquid/vapour mass distribution. It does not by itself report dissolved salts, contamination, cleanliness or whether steam is suitable for a medical/food process.

Quality is meaningful for an appropriate saturated two-phase state, including endpoint conventions. It is not a general label for every gas state; superheated steam is not described by “x greater than 1”.

In practice, a flowing non-equilibrium mixture and entrained boiler water may need additional sampling/measurement considerations. This lesson gives the basic equilibrium definition and does not claim a real plant’s quality has been measured.
body.gu:
Thermodynamic Steam quality liquid/vapour નો mass distribution બતાવે છે. તે પોતે salts, contamination અથવા medical/food process માટે suitability બતાવતું નથી.

તે યોગ્ય saturated two-phase state અને endpoint convention માટે છે. દરેક gas state નો rating નથી; superheated માટે x>1 ન લખાય.

Actual flowing/non-equilibrium mixture અને entrained boiler water માટે અલગ measurement considerations હોઈ શકે. અહીં basic equilibrium definition છે; કોઈ real plant નું quality measurement કર્યાનો દાવો નથી.

body.en:
Priming in a boiler is the carryover of liquid boiler water with the outgoing steam. It can increase steam moisture and carry dissolved/entrained impurities into downstream equipment.

Priming is not the same as intentionally filling a centrifugal pump before starting; that is another engineering use of the same word and is covered in the Pumps unit.

Foaming involves persistent bubbles/froth at the water surface; it can encourage carryover. Priming and foaming are related but not identical terms.
body.gu:
Boiler માં Priming એટલે outgoing steam સાથે liquid boiler water carryover થવું. તેથી moisture વધે અને impurities downstream equipment સુધી જઈ શકે.

આ centrifugal pump શરૂ કરતાં પહેલાં તેને ભરવાના Priming થી જુદું છે; એક જ શબ્દનો અલગ context છે, Pumps unit માં આવશે.

Foaming એટલે water surface પર persistent bubbles/froth; તે carryover વધારી શકે. Priming અને foaming જોડાયેલા પણ અલગ terms છે.

body.en:
Contributing conditions: excessive water level, rapid/sudden steam-demand changes, high steam-release velocities and water conditions that promote foaming/carryover. Exact causes depend on boiler design and operation.

Possible effects: wetter steam, deposits/contamination in downstream devices, loss of useful performance and damaging water accumulation or mechanical effects under adverse conditions.

A visible plume alone cannot quantify priming. Abnormal water/steam behaviour in a plant must be assessed by trained operators with approved procedures and instrument evidence.
body.gu:
ફાળો આપતાં conditions: વધારે water level, steam demand માં અચાનક ફેરફાર, વધારે release velocity અને foaming/carryover પ્રોત્સાહિત કરતી water condition. Actual cause design/operation પર આધારિત છે.

અસરો: વધારે wet steam, downstream deposits/contamination, performance loss અને ખરાબ condition માં water accumulation/mechanical damage.

ફક્ત visible cloud જોઈને priming નું પ્રમાણ ન નક્કી થાય. Actual plant માં trained operator, instruments અને approved procedure જરૂરી છે.

h.gu: 3.6.3 Prevention ના સિદ્ધાંતો અને Operator ની મર્યાદા

body.en:
General prevention principles include maintaining the approved operating water-level range, avoiding inappropriate rapid load changes, controlling boiler-water condition through the specified treatment programme and using suitable separation equipment where designed.

These are principles, not operating instructions. Water-level adjustments, blowdown, chemical dosing, pressure control and separator maintenance must be performed only by authorised trained personnel under the plant’s approved procedures.

Do not open drains, adjust safety valves or experiment with a hot pressurised boiler. A classroom model/diagram is the appropriate study aid for this concept.
body.gu:
General prevention માં approved water-level range જાળવવી, અયોગ્ય sudden load changes ટાળવા, specified water-treatment programme અને designed separation equipment નો ઉપયોગ આવે છે.

આ Principles છે, operating instructions નહીં. Water level, blowdown, chemical dosing, pressure control અથવા separator service ફક્ત authorised trained staff approved procedure થી કરે.

Hot pressurised boiler પર drain ખોલવું, safety valve adjust કરવું અથવા experiment ન કરવો. Study માટે diagram/model યોગ્ય છે.

body.en:
• Define pure substance and show that two phases may have the same chemical composition.
  • Explain constant-pressure steam formation using a labelled conceptual heating curve.
  • Distinguish wet, dry saturated and superheated steam at a specified pressure.
  • State meanings/units of degree and heat of superheat; do not add unnecessary derivations.
  • Explain dryness/quality and wetness as mass fractions.
  • Explain boiler priming with causes/effects and safety-aware prevention principles.
  • Use Notes for learning; Exam tab deliberately contains questions only.
body.gu:
• Pure substance વ્યાખ્યા અને same composition ના બે phases સમજાવો.
  • Labelled heating curve વડે constant-pressure steam formation સમજાવો.
  • Specified pressure પર Wet, Dry saturated અને Superheated જુદાં પાડો.
  • Degree/Heat of superheat નો અર્થ અને units જાણો; વધારાની derivation નહીં.
  • Dryness/Quality અને Wetness ને mass fractions તરીકે સમજાવો.
  • Boiler priming ના કારણો/અસરો અને safe prevention principles જાણો.
  • Notes માં અભ્યાસ કરો; Exam tab માં ઇરાદાપૂર્વક ફક્ત પ્રશ્નો છે.

title.en: Steam states at a specified pressure
title.gu: Steam states at a specified pressure

items.f: Tsat corresponds to specified absolute p

terms.en: Water does not always boil at 100 °C.
terms.gu: Water હંમેશાં 100 °C પર boil નથી થતું.

terms.en: At fixed p: mixture/end point at Tsat; superheated above Tsat.
terms.gu: Fixed p પર mixture/endpoint Tsat; superheated તેની ઉપર.

terms.en: A temperature difference, not heat energy.
Approximate q≈Cp,avg deltaT only with suitable assumptions.
terms.gu: યોગ્ય assumptions સાથે જ q≈Cp,avg deltaT approximation.

terms.en: Mass fraction; not volume fraction or purity rating.

items.f: Boiler water carried with outgoing steam

terms.en: Learn principles; do not operate or adjust live boilers.
terms.gu: Principles શીખો; live boiler operate/adjust નહીં.

q.en: What is a pure substance?
q.gu: Pure substance શું છે?

a.en: A substance with fixed chemical composition throughout the system considered.
a.gu: વિચારેલા system માં fixed chemical composition ધરાવતો substance.

q.en: Can liquid water and its vapour form a pure-substance system?
q.gu: Water અને તેની vapour pure-substance system હોઈ શકે?

a.en: Yes, both phases have the chemical identity H₂O.
a.gu: હા, બંને phases H₂O છે.

q.en: What is steam?
q.gu: Steam શું છે?

a.en: Water vapour; wet steam refers to a liquid–vapour mixture.
a.gu: Water vapour; Wet steam માં liquid–vapour mixture છે.

q.en: Is visible white cloud pure invisible vapour?
q.gu: સફેદ cloud એટલે invisible vapour જ છે?

a.en: No. It commonly contains tiny condensed liquid droplets.
a.gu: ના; સામાન્ય રીતે નાના condensed liquid droplets હોય છે.

q.en: What is saturation temperature?
q.gu: Saturation temperature શું?

a.en: Liquid–vapour equilibrium temperature at a specified pressure.
a.gu: Specified pressure પર liquid–vapour equilibrium T.

q.en: Does water always boil at 100 °C?
q.gu: Water હંમેશાં 100 °C પર boil થાય?

a.en: No, boiling/saturation temperature depends on pressure.
a.gu: ના; saturation T pressure પર આધારિત છે.

q.en: Which pressure basis is used for steam properties?
q.gu: Steam properties માટે કયું pressure?

a.en: Absolute pressure.
a.gu: Absolute pressure.

q.en: What is saturated liquid?
q.gu: Saturated liquid શું?

a.en: The liquid-side state at the boiling boundary for its pressure.
a.gu: તે pressure માટે boiling boundary ની liquid-side state.

q.en: Why can heat be added while boiling temperature stays constant?
q.gu: Boiling T constant હોવા છતાં heat શા માટે અપાય?

a.en: At constant pressure it supports phase change and the associated energy changes/expansion.
a.gu: Constant pressure પર phase change અને સંબંધિત energy/expansion માટે.

q.en: What is wet steam?
q.gu: Wet steam શું?

a.en: Liquid water and water vapour together.
a.gu: Liquid water અને water vapour નું mixture.

q.en: What is dry saturated steam?
q.gu: Dry saturated steam શું?

a.en: The saturated-vapour endpoint with no equilibrium liquid fraction.
a.gu: Equilibrium liquid fraction વગરનું saturated-vapour endpoint.

q.en: Is dry saturated steam superheated?
q.gu: Dry saturated એટલે Superheated?

a.en: No. Dry saturated is at Tsat; superheated is above it at the same pressure.
a.gu: ના; same p પર dry saturated Tsat પર અને superheated તેની ઉપર.

q.en: Define degree of superheat.
q.gu: Degree of superheat ની વ્યાખ્યા?

a.en: Tsup minus Tsat at the same pressure.
a.gu: Same pressure પર Tsup−Tsat.

q.en: What units describe degree of superheat?
q.gu: Degree of superheat ના units?

a.en: A temperature difference, K or equivalently degree-C difference.
a.gu: Temperature difference: K અથવા સમકક્ષ °C નો તફાવત.

q.en: Is heat of superheat a temperature?
q.gu: Heat of superheat Temperature છે?

a.en: No. It is energy, on total or per-mass basis.
a.gu: ના; કુલ અથવા unit mass દીઠ energy છે.

q.en: Define dryness fraction x.
q.gu: Dryness fraction x શું?

a.en: Vapour mass divided by total liquid-plus-vapour mass.
a.gu: Vapour mass / કુલ liquid+vapour mass.

q.en: What is steam quality in this unit?
q.gu: અહીં Steam quality શું?

a.en: Dryness fraction of the saturated mixture, not chemical purity.
a.gu: Saturated mixture નો dryness fraction, chemical purity નહીં.

q.en: Define wetness fraction.
q.gu: Wetness fraction ની વ્યાખ્યા?

a.en: Liquid mass fraction; 1−x.
a.gu: Liquid mass fraction; 1−x.

q.en: Does x=0.9 mean 90% vapour by volume?
q.gu: x=0.9 એટલે volume ના 90% vapour?

a.en: No. It is 90% by mass.
a.gu: ના; mass ના 90% છે.

q.en: Is x=1.2 a valid superheated-steam quality?
q.gu: Superheated માટે x=1.2 ચાલે?

a.en: No. Saturated-mixture quality is not defined that way outside its range.
a.gu: ના; saturated-mixture quality આ રીતે range બહાર લાગુ નથી.

q.en: What is boiler priming?
q.gu: Boiler priming શું?

a.en: Liquid boiler-water carryover with outgoing steam.
a.gu: Outgoing steam સાથે liquid boiler water carryover.

q.en: Are priming and foaming identical?
q.gu: Priming અને foaming એક જ છે?

a.en: No. Foaming can contribute to carryover, but the meanings differ.
a.gu: ના; foaming carryover માં ફાળો આપી શકે, પણ અર્થ જુદા છે.

q.en: Is boiler priming the same as pump priming?
q.gu: Boiler અને pump priming સમાન?

a.en: No. Pump priming concerns filling/preparation under its procedure.
a.gu: ના; Pump priming filling/preparation નો અલગ context છે.

q.en: May a student adjust a hot boiler to prevent priming?
q.gu: Student hot boiler adjust કરી શકે?

a.en: No. Only authorised trained staff follow approved plant procedures.
a.gu: ના; authorised trained staff approved procedure થી કરે.

q.en: Practice: Define a pure substance. Explain how water and steam may coexist as a pure substance.
q.gu: Practice: Pure substance વ્યાખ્યા અને water/steam coexistence સમજાવો.

q.en: Practice: Explain steam and distinguish invisible vapour from a visible condensed plume.
q.gu: Practice: Steam સમજાવો અને invisible vapour તથા visible cloud જુદા પાડો.

q.en: Practice: Define saturation temperature and saturation pressure and state their relationship.
q.gu: Practice: Saturation T/p વ્યાખ્યા અને સંબંધ જણાવો.

q.en: Practice: Explain steam formation at constant pressure with a labelled heating curve.
q.gu: Practice: Labelled heating curve સાથે constant-pressure steam formation સમજાવો.

q.en: Practice: Explain saturated liquid and the wet mixture during vaporisation.
q.gu: Practice: Saturated liquid અને vaporisation દરમિયાન wet mixture સમજાવો.

q.en: Practice: Differentiate wet, dry saturated and superheated steam.
q.gu: Practice: Wet, Dry saturated અને Superheated steam સરખાવો.

q.en: Practice: Explain why boiling may continue at constant temperature while heat is supplied.
q.gu: Practice: Heat આપવા છતાં boiling T constant કેમ રહી શકે તે સમજાવો.

q.en: Practice: Define degree of superheat and state the pressure condition required.
q.gu: Practice: Degree of superheat વ્યાખ્યા અને pressure ની શરત જણાવો.

q.en: Practice: Explain heat of superheat and distinguish it from degree of superheat.
q.gu: Practice: Heat of superheat સમજાવો અને Degree થી ફરક જણાવો.

q.en: Practice: Define dryness fraction and explain its mass basis.
q.gu: Practice: Dryness fraction અને તેનો mass basis સમજાવો.

q.en: Practice: Explain quality and wetness fraction and state their relationship.
q.gu: Practice: Quality/Wetness સમજાવો અને સંબંધ જણાવો.

q.en: Practice: Explain why saturated-mixture quality is not assigned above one for superheated steam.
q.gu: Practice: Superheated steam માટે quality એકથી વધારે કેમ ન આપીએ તે સમજાવો.

q.en: Practice: Explain boiler priming and distinguish it from foaming and pump priming.
q.gu: Practice: Boiler priming ને foaming અને pump priming થી જુદું સમજાવો.

q.en: Practice: State causes, effects and safe prevention principles of boiler priming.
q.gu: Practice: Boiler priming ના કારણો, અસરો અને safe prevention principles જણાવો.

q.en: Practice: Describe the reverse state sequence when superheated steam is cooled at constant pressure.
q.gu: Practice: Constant p પર superheated steam ઠંડી કરતાં reverse state sequence સમજાવો.

q.en: Practice: Distinguish steam quality from chemical purity and explain why pressure must be known to classify steam.
q.gu: Practice: Quality/Purity નો ફરક અને steam classify કરવા pressure શા માટે જોઈએ તે સમજાવો.
